sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Brighten up your look with these stunning multicolor crystal cluster stud earrings, crafted with a luxurious gold-plated finish. Featuring a vibrant mix of marquise and princess-cut stones in pink, mint green, amber, lavender, and clear CZ, these earrings create a dazzling floral burst design that instantly catches the eye.
- Lightweight yet glamorous, these studs are perfect for festive celebrations, parties, weddings, and special occasions. Their colorful and versatile style pairs beautifully with ethnic, Indo-western, and modern outfits, adding a bold and fashionable pop of color.
- Keywords included: multicolor earrings, crystal cluster studs, gold-plated jewelry, festive earrings for women, colorful stone earrings, party wear studs, statement earrings
